description: This Java class 'CreateOrderFromCartFlow' orchestrates the checkout process by converting a shopping cart into an order. It coordinates interactions with cart and order services, performs validation, and manages control flow and error handling.

classes.name: CreateOrderFromCartFlow
classes.description: A Spring Service class that orchestrates creating an order from a shopping cart through validation, mapping, and calling downstream services.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main public method that performs checkout orchestration, including cart validation, mapping to create order request, calling order service, and handling exceptions.

methods.name: validateCartMatchesRequest
methods.description: Validates that the cart matches the provided IDs and contains necessary information like currency.

methods.name: mapCartToCreateOrder
methods.description: Maps cart response data into a create order request, setting merchant, customer, currency, and order items.
